person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects an official Army row for Leonard A Colavita, establishing that the printed Leoonard form is a spelling difference. The row dates Army entry to 3 July 1943 as a private and carries civilian-occupation code 992.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-July 1943 school records to identify Leonard A Colavita's school, study dates and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A 1943 Office of Price Administration manual names John A. Colborn, Jr. as the federal mileage administrator for the Office of Strategic Services. The exact three-part name and OSS context support a probable match, but the identifier-free Box 133 row omits the suffix and provides no second independent identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to confirm the John A. Colborn, Jr. identity and reconstruct his occupation, employer and chronology before the 1943 OSS administrative role.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index gives John H Colby a short six-digit identifier, no rank and Box 133. One exact-name Army row carries a different standard identifier; the short index value was not padded or altered to force a match. Exact-name public-source checks did not establish the indexed identity.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to determine the identifier system and establish John H Colby's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact full name and middle initial in the NARA index, corroborated by a CIA Museum narrative documenting Army commission, active duty and OSS recruitment. The index's short six-digit identifier is preserved literally and is not matched to either same-name Army merged-file row.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to resolve William E Colby's exact OSS transfer date and determine whether any civilian employer preceded Army service; the verified immediate Army affiliation is not itself a verified employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects the official Army row for Calvin H Colding, supplying middle initial H. The row dates Army entry to 7 May 1943 as a private and carries civilian-occupation code 736.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 and pre-May 1943 directories to identify Calvin H Colding's actual work, employer and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 133 to establish Anita B Cole's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.
